company has two separate problems. it prepended TAN WOON YANN, which is the first line of the OCR and looks like a person rather than the business, so that is a real judgement call about where the company name starts and the label says it is not part of it. separately it wrote SDN BND where the label says SDN BHD, but the OCR also says BND, so the model copied its input correctly and the label came from somewhere the model cannot see. address differs only by a trailing full stop the model dropped, unclear whether that is supposed to count.
